notes: The whole pipeline is feedback driven, but individual LLM annotators are stateless, tool-free, and unable to plan (lines 136–140). No LLM training, retrieval memory, live alert deployment, or cross-task reuse is demonstrated. Classification and quality flags support the anomaly objective rather than independently evaluated task families. Process evidence is rationale/flag consistency rather than tool-call success. Temporal evidence checks numerical amplitude meaning, supplemented by phase-shift/crop robustness in Appendix C; it does not establish chronological splits or availability-time control. Ordinary labeled/unlabeled centering leakage control is not treated as chronological evidence. API cost and catalog yield are not downstream decision utility; completeness is unknown. Reconciliation preserves both existing mechanism IDs and separates initialization from acquisition; the image interface and targeted consensus procedure are additional packet-supported modules omitted by the current card. Future classification, alert triage, RAG, external tools, and other-survey deployment are excluded.

reconciliation.reason: Lines 267–291 substantiate a contributed integration beyond unchanged isolation forests: class-conditional training, period/range inputs, and minimum cross-class percentile ranking. This task-specific scoring can initialize a search independently of later LLM feedback, so it remains separate. Step A had grouped initialization with acquisition; reconciliation separates it to preserve the existing mechanism and ID.
